record.paper_title: Some open problems about aspherical closed manifolds
record.original_question: Let G be a torsionfree group. Is it true that the negative algebraic K-groups Kn(ZG) vanish for all n <= -1, that the reduced projective class group K̃0(ZG) vanishes, that the Whitehead group Wh(G) vanishes, and that for every homomorphism w: G -> {±1} the w-twisted L-theoretic assembly map Hn(BG; wL⟨−∞⟩) -> L⟨−∞⟩n(RG,w) is bijective?

artifact.category_tag: Farrell-Jones conjecture / algebraic K- and L-theory of group rings
artifact.status_search_result: These four statements are well-known consequences of the Farrell–Jones Conjecture (with integer coefficients) for torsionfree groups. The Farrell–Jones Conjecture has been verified for many classes of groups (hyperbolic groups, CAT(0) groups, virtually solvable groups, lattices in virtually connected Lie groups, mapping class groups, etc.) but remains open for general torsionfree groups; no counterexamples are known. Consequently the four vanishing/isomorphism statements remain open in full generality.
